definitions.eligibleWeeks: Only a regular-season week with the expected full paired league: eight teams in 2016, ten in later years; exclude incomplete 2020/21 Week 14 for all managers in those years.
definitions.allPlayWins: For each manager's week, number of all other teams that they scored more points than; tied-score opponents count as half in expected wins.
definitions.expectedWins: Sum across fully paired weeks of (other teams beaten plus half of tied teams)/(N-1). Equivalent to expected wins against one randomly selected league opponent each week, independent of actual schedule constraints.
definitions.scheduleDrawSurplus: Actual wins plus half actual ties minus normalized all-play expected wins. A descriptive opponent draw difference, NOT causal proof of luck, management, playoff results or counterfactual schedule permutations.
definitions.comparability: Raw sums cover 12–14 weeks depending on season (2016 8 teams); 2026 Week 8 snapshot is provisional.
